recipes.name: Macher jhol
steps: Rub fish with turmeric and salt and lightly fry in mustard oil.
Fry potato wedges, add cumin, ginger, tomato and spices.
Add water, simmer, then add the fish and cook through.

recipes.name: Shorshe ilish
steps: Grind mustard seeds with chilli and a pinch of salt.
Mix the paste with curd, turmeric, water and mustard oil.
Cook the hilsa in the sauce covered on low heat.

recipes.name: Chingri malai curry
steps: Sear prawns with turmeric in mustard oil.
Cook onion paste and ginger in ghee with whole spices.
Add coconut milk, sugar and prawns and simmer briefly.

recipes.name: Aloo posto
steps: Grind poppy seeds (sesame stands in for nutrition) with chilli.
Fry potato cubes in mustard oil with a little turmeric.
Add the paste and water and cook until coated and dry.

recipes.name: Shukto
steps: Fry bitter gourd and set aside.
Cook the other vegetables with panch phoron and ginger.
Add mustard paste and milk, simmer, finish with ghee and the bitter gourd.

recipes.name: Cholar dal
steps: Cook soaked chana dal until soft but whole.
Fry coconut bits, cumin and whole spices in ghee.
Add the dal, sugar, raisins and ginger and simmer.

recipes.name: Begun bhaja
steps: Slice brinjal into rounds.
Rub with turmeric, chilli, sugar and salt.
Shallow-fry in mustard oil until soft.

recipes.name: Kosha mangsho
steps: Marinate mutton in curd, ginger, garlic and spices.
Caramelise sugar and onion in mustard oil.
Add the mutton and potato and slow-cook, stirring, until dark and tender.

recipes.name: Luchi
steps: Knead maida with ghee, salt and water.
Roll small thin rounds.
Deep-fry until puffed.

recipes.name: Aloor dom
steps: Parboil and fry baby potatoes.
Cook ginger, tomato, curd and spices into a thick gravy.
Simmer the potatoes covered until coated.

recipes.name: Rosogolla
steps: Knead fresh chhena with a little semolina until smooth.
Shape small balls.
Boil in sugar syrup covered for 15 minutes and cool in the syrup.

recipes.name: Mishti doi
steps: Reduce milk by a third.
Stir in caramelised jaggery and cool to lukewarm.
Add curd starter and set in clay pots overnight.

recipes.name: Jhalmuri
steps: Toss puffed rice with chopped vegetables and peanuts.
Add raw mustard oil, chilli and masala.
Squeeze lemon and serve at once.

recipes.name: Kolkata egg roll
steps: Make a layered maida paratha.
Cook a beaten egg on the tawa and press the paratha onto it.
Fill with onion, cucumber, chilli, ketchup and lemon and roll.

recipes.name: Dalma
steps: Cook toor dal with the vegetables and turmeric.
Season with roasted cumin-chilli powder.
Temper with ghee and panch phoron and add coconut.

recipes.name: Pakhala bhata
steps: Soak cooked rice in water overnight to ferment lightly.
Stir in curd and salt.
Temper with curry leaves and serve with fried sides.

recipes.name: Chhena poda
steps: Knead chhena with sugar, semolina and cardamom.
Press into a greased tin.
Bake until caramelised on the outside.

recipes.name: Litti chokha
steps: Mix sattu with garlic, ginger, ajwain, lemon and mustard oil.
Stuff into atta balls and bake until crusty, then dip in ghee.
Roast brinjal, tomato and potato and mash with garlic and mustard oil into chokha.

recipes.name: Sattu paratha
steps: Mix roasted gram flour with onion, chilli, ajwain, lemon and mustard oil.
Stuff into dough and roll out.
Cook with ghee on a tawa.

recipes.name: Sattu sharbat
steps: Whisk roasted gram flour into cold water.
Add lemon, roasted cumin, mint and black salt.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Thekua
steps: Dissolve jaggery in a little water.
Knead with atta, ghee, coconut, fennel and cardamom into a stiff dough.
Press into moulds and deep-fry slowly.

recipes.name: Masor tenga
steps: Fry fish lightly with turmeric.
Temper fenugreek, cook tomatoes down with chilli.
Add water and fish, simmer and finish with lemon and coriander.

recipes.name: Kol khar
steps: Cook raw papaya or banana and dal with khar (alkaline water).
Temper garlic and ginger in mustard oil.
Simmer until soft and serve with rice as the first course.

recipes.name: Aloo pitika
steps: Boil and mash potatoes.
Mix with raw onion, chilli and coriander.
Finish with raw mustard oil and salt.

recipes.name: Chicken with ash gourd
steps: Brown onion, ginger and garlic in mustard oil.
Add chicken and spices and sear.
Add ash gourd and simmer until both are tender.

recipes.name: Pork with bamboo shoot
steps: Cook pork in its own fat with ginger, garlic and chilli.
Add fermented bamboo shoot and tomato.
Simmer with a little water until tender.

recipes.name: Smoked pork with king chilli
steps: Boil smoked pork with ginger and garlic.
Add potato, tomato and crushed chilli.
Cook until the pork is tender and the gravy thick.

recipes.name: Eromba
steps: Boil the vegetables until soft.
Roast fermented fish and chillies and mash.
Mash everything together and garnish with spring onion and coriander.

recipes.name: Chak-hao kheer
steps: Soak the black rice.
Simmer in milk until creamy.
Sweeten and add cardamom and nuts.

recipes.name: Chicken momos
steps: Mix minced chicken with onion, cabbage, ginger, garlic, soy and oil.
Fill thin maida wrappers and pleat.
Steam 10–12 minutes and serve with chilli chutney.

recipes.name: Veg momos
steps: Sauté shredded vegetables with ginger and garlic and add crumbled paneer.
Fill wrappers and pleat.
Steam 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken thukpa
steps: Simmer chicken in water with ginger and garlic to make a broth.
Add vegetables and soy and cook briefly.
Add boiled noodles and spring onion and serve hot.
